plain_description.what: On the combined clean pool, compares the routing gain of the anchor-free tree's cells with two baselines. One simply routes by dataset (6 cells). The other uses 200 random cell sets of the same sizes drawn inside each dataset.
plain_description.why: It asks how much of the tree's +1.5-point routing gain comes from just knowing which dataset a question came from.
plain_description.information: It separates gain from real structure from gain that only reflects the dataset label. Result: UNDETERMINED. The tree's cells beat dataset-only routing by +0.5 points, but the interval includes zero, so "better than dataset routing" is not shown at this sample size. The gain is above what random cells of the same size give, so the dataset alone does not explain it either. The cells are source-conditioned (they use the dataset label), so this is not a label-free gain.
